summary: A date, five figures, and nothing else. Location undisclosed, line-up sealed.
body: One date has been set: 13 December 2026. Nothing else has been announced.
The location stays undisclosed and the line-up stays sealed until closer to the night. What is confirmed is who stands behind it — Hidden State, No Problem and SJ.
Updates will appear here first.

ro.summary: O dată, cinci siluete și nimic altceva. Locația nedezvăluită, line-up-ul sigilat.
body: O singură dată a fost stabilită: 13 decembrie 2026. Nimic altceva nu a fost anunțat.
Locația rămâne nedezvăluită, iar line-up-ul rămâne sigilat până mai aproape de noapte. Ce este confirmat este cine se află în spate — Hidden State, No Problem și SJ.
Actualizările vor apărea mai întâi aici.

headline: Claire Cruz joins Hidden State
summary: The Dubai-based DJ and producer brings Afro House, melodic techno and tribal elements — and a debut single, “Pearl of Sand.”
caption: Claire Cruz
body: A new collaboration brings Claire Cruz into the Hidden State network, another step toward a stronger international presence and connecting fresh talent with new opportunities.

Filipino-Spanish and based in Dubai, she is a DJ and producer and the founder of Impact Studio FZE and InfluencersDubai.AE. She stepped into music after a career across events, marketing and influencer management.

Her debut single, “Pearl of Sand,” introduces a sound blending Afro House, melodic techno and tribal elements into a dark, hypnotic atmosphere. Following the debut she takes her music beyond Dubai, with Romania marking her first festival performance in Europe and outside the UAE.
signoff: “Pearl of Sand” is only the beginning.

ro.headline: Claire Cruz se alătură Hidden State
ro.summary: DJ-ul și producătoarea din Dubai aduce Afro House, techno melodic și elemente tribale — și un prim single, „Pearl of Sand”.
body: O nouă colaborare o aduce pe Claire Cruz în rețeaua Hidden State, încă un pas către o prezență internațională mai puternică și către conectarea talentelor noi cu oportunități noi.

Filipineză-spaniolă și stabilită în Dubai, este DJ și producătoare și fondatoarea Impact Studio FZE și InfluencersDubai.AE. A intrat în muzică după o carieră în evenimente, marketing și management de influenceri.

Primul ei single, „Pearl of Sand”, introduce un sunet care îmbină Afro House, techno melodic și elemente tribale într-o atmosferă întunecată și hipnotică. După debut, își duce muzica dincolo de Dubai, România marcând prima ei apariție la un festival în Europa și în afara Emiratelor.

headline: Tess Wich joins Hidden State
summary: Australian hard techno — dark atmospheres, hypnotic grooves and sets built for the dancefloor.
caption: Tess Wich — Tech Wich
body: Tess Wich joins the Hidden State roster. An Australian DJ and electronic music artist performing as Tech Wich, she is known for a powerful hard techno, peak-time, hard bounce and rave sound.

Her sets bring dark atmospheres, hypnotic grooves and high energy, built for the dancefloor rather than for headphones. With a distinctive visual identity and an evolving international presence, she is quickly making her mark on the global techno scene.
signoff: Dark atmospheres. Hypnotic grooves. Built for the floor.

ro.headline: Tess Wich se alătură Hidden State
ro.summary: Hard techno australian — atmosfere întunecate, groove-uri hipnotice și seturi construite pentru ringul de dans.
body: Tess Wich se alătură rosterului Hidden State. DJ și artistă de muzică electronică din Australia, care evoluează sub numele Tech Wich, este cunoscută pentru un sunet puternic de hard techno, peak-time, hard bounce și rave.

Seturile ei aduc atmosfere întunecate, groove-uri hipnotice și energie ridicată, construite pentru ringul de dans, nu pentru căști. Cu o identitate vizuală distinctă și o prezență internațională în creștere, își face rapid loc pe scena techno globală.
ro.signoff: Atmosfere întunecate. Groove-uri hipnotice. Construite pentru ring.

headline: Creamfields, UK — 27–30 August 2026
summary: Four of dance music's biggest names head to Daresbury: Calvin Harris, Martin Garrix, Armin van Buuren and Tiësto.
body: Creamfields returns to Daresbury from 27 to 30 August 2026, and the bill at the top reads like a history of the last two decades of dance music.

Calvin Harris has shaped modern dance music with global hits, iconic collaborations and festival performances that define the format. Martin Garrix rose to global fame on his signature festival sound and has stayed at the front of the scene ever since.

Armin van Buuren has spent decades defining the global trance scene through his productions, his radio show and his live performances. Tiësto's career spans more than twenty years, from pioneering trance to dominating modern festival stages, reinventing himself repeatedly along the way.

ro.headline: Creamfields, Marea Britanie — 27–30 august 2026
ro.summary: Patru zile, unul dintre cele mai mari festivaluri de muzică electronică din lume.

headline: Black Coffee at Hi Ibiza
summary: The South African Afro House figurehead runs his Ibiza dates through August and September, closing on 3 October.
body: Black Coffee plays Hi Ibiza across August and September, with a closing set on 3 October.

The South African DJ and producer is known for a signature blend of Afro House, deep electronic sound and African influences, built into a career that spans the biggest festivals and clubs worldwide. With a Grammy Award and a reputation as one of Africa's most influential electronic artists, he continues to shape the global sound of Afro House.

ro.headline: Black Coffee la Hï Ibiza
ro.summary: Rezidența Black Coffee continuă la Hï Ibiza.

headline: Indira Paganotto at Hi Ibiza
summary: The Spanish psy-techno force takes Hi Ibiza through August and September, closing on 4 October.
body: Indira Paganotto plays Hi Ibiza across August and September, closing on 4 October.

The Spanish DJ and producer is one of the leading names in psy-techno, known for an energetic, hypnotic sound that blends underground techno with psytrance influences. She has performed at major festivals and clubs worldwide, including Tomorrowland, Awakenings, EXIT and EDC Las Vegas, and founded ARTCORE, a label closely associated with the modern psy-techno movement.

headline: Miss Monique at Hi Ibiza
summary: The Ukrainian progressive house and melodic techno name plays through August and September, closing on 24 September.
body: Miss Monique plays Hi Ibiza across August and September, with a closing set on 24 September.

The Ukrainian DJ and producer is one of the leading names in progressive house and melodic techno. Known for a powerful, emotional sound and for performing worldwide, she has become a major force in the modern electronic music scene, playing some of the world's biggest festivals and clubs.

headline: B.MIKE joins Hidden State, creating something new and unique
summary: A young Romanian DJ with perfect pitch, a festival record already behind him, and a charitable project raising funds for autism therapy.
caption: B.MIKE — Heartbeat Vibes
body: B.MIKE started DJing in 2022 and is part of OWPN Academy. Since then he has performed at major festivals including UNTOLD, Electric Castle, Flight Festival, Take Off Festival, Codru Festival, Snow Fest France, Nassau Festival, Univibes and Takeover.

His achievements include the Timisoara Music Awards New Talent Award (2023) and Tech-House Award (2024), a place among the five finalists in the Drum & Bass category (2025), and an Excellence Award from Flight Festival in 2025.

He has played venues across Romania including Fratelli Timisoara, Form Space Cluj and Underground Pub Iasi, sharing stages with Carla's Dreams, DJ Project, Alina Eremia, Feli, Elena Gheorghe and Lidia Buble.

Since March 2026 he has been part of EPICA, a charitable music project alongside Pascal Junior, Jayko, Silviu Andrei and Mindblow, raising funds to support access to therapy for people with autism. Musically he moves between 2000s retro, EDM, house, tech-house and drum & bass, with sets running from 128 to 175 BPM.
signoff: Turning passion into ability, and ability into music.

ro.headline: B.MIKE se alătură Hidden State
ro.summary: Heartbeat Vibes — B.MIKE intră în rosterul Hidden State.

headline: DJ Tengu joins Hidden State, shaping the world of music
summary: An old-school spirit joins the roster — hip-hop, R&B, funk, soul and classic urban records, played for atmosphere rather than effect.
caption: DJ Tengu behind the decks
body: DJ Tengu is driven by passion, talent, and a genuine love for music. With experience behind the decks and an unmistakable old-school spirit, he brings a sound that connects generations and keeps the energy alive.
His selections travel through the golden sounds of old school hip-hop, R&B, funk, soul, rap and classic urban music, blending timeless records with his own style and personality.

For DJ Tengu, music is more than just playing tracks — it's about creating an atmosphere, telling a story and making people feel every beat. With dedication, character and a constant desire to evolve, he continues to shape his own path through sound.
kicker: Old soul. Real music. New energy.
footnote: Some sounds are heard. Others are remembered.

ro.headline: DJ Tengu se alătură Hidden State
ro.summary: Hip-hop și R&B din anii '90, funk clasic din anii '80–'90.

headline: Astryon Festival Launch Party
summary: The first chapter opens on 28 August 2026 with a thirteen-artist line-up ahead of the festival itself.
caption: Astryon Festival Launch Party — 28 August 2026
body: The Astryon Festival Launch Party lands on 28 August 2026 — the opening moment before the festival's first chapter.
Thirteen artists play across the night, spanning the range the festival itself will cover.

ro.summary: Hidden State la lansarea Astryon Festival.
body: Stephanno Jr. a mixat la petrecerea de lansare a Astryon Festival, marcând începutul drumului către festivalul de pe litoralul Mării Negre.

headline: Mario Daniel aka DJ Mario — new set
summary: Fill & Dance explores the deeper, more energetic side of Afro House across a set built to be felt from beginning to end.
caption: DJ Mario — Fill & Dance
body: A new soundscape arrives through the latest set from DJ Mario, bringing together the energy, warmth and hypnotic character of Afro House in a journey designed to be felt from beginning to end.

With a carefully selected tracklist, flowing transitions and a strong focus on rhythm, “Fill & Dance” explores the deeper and more energetic side of Afro House. The set moves naturally between atmospheric moments, powerful grooves and uplifting rhythms, creating an experience that feels equally at home on the dancefloor, during a late-night drive, or simply with the volume turned up.
More than just a collection of tracks, this set captures Mario's approach to music — letting the rhythm build naturally while keeping the energy alive throughout the entire journey.
From the first beat to the final transition, Fill & Dance is about movement, atmosphere and connection through sound.
signoff: Press play. Feel the rhythm. Fill the space.

ro.headline: Mario Daniel — Fill & Dance
ro.summary: Un nou set de la Mario Daniel.
